title: Pointwise finite intrinsic tensor comparison
statement: For a finite coefficient level m, a field E and a fixed SixFunctorSpace X, there is an isomorphism identifying finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor with evaluatedTensor at X.

source.place: The simultaneous flat K-flat representative comparison at one ambient finite input

proof.text: Use the canonical pullback tensor model, whose tensor is definitionally identified with the finite intrinsic tensor by pullbackTensorFiniteModelIso. Apply the proved finiteScalarTensorRealization to the transported fixed tensor. Whisker that comparison by the realization inverse in both variables, use the currying counit, and transport along the realization counit. The resulting natural isomorphism is the displayed evaluatedTensor comparison.

proof_origin.place: Pointwise comparison obtained by whiskering the normalized finite scalar realization with the inverse realization and the finite tensor model.

theorem finiteIntrinsicTensorRealization_component
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (m : ℕ)
    (X : SixFunctorSpace D) :
    Nonempty (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor C.l E X.obj.left m ≅
      evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m X)
